want: 林道を走れる 2 人乗りの小さな電動のオフロード車両 (電池で走る 4 輪、最高 40 km/h、500 kg まで、積載 150 kg)

requirements.name: 路面の摩擦係数 (砂利)
requirements.basis: assumption (gravel; no public value found)

requirements.name: 路面の粗さ (ISO 8608 のクラス)
requirements.basis: assumption: the forest road taken as ISO 8608 class C. ISO 8608 covers unpaved roads too (https://www.iso.org/standard/71202.html); class C = 128-512 x 10^-6 m^3 at n0 = 0.1 cycle/m from the table in https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s12544-013-0127-8 (not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 縦の坂 (止まって発進できる一番急な坂)
requirements.basis: 林道規程 (林野庁) 第 20 条: 縦断勾配 12 % は第 1 項のただし書、14 % は第 4 項の 2 級林道の例外 (the steepest stretch), https://www.rinya.maff.go.jp/hokkaido/keikaku/other/attach/pdf/sinrinkeikaku_taikei-32.pdf (the article and its paragraphs read for this repository). The sustained 12 % is the forest loop's grade_high in data/catalog/tests.yaml (P4, T1, T2)

requirements.name: 横の傾き
requirements.basis: assumption (no basis found)

requirements.name: 段差
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 横風 (瞬間)
requirements.basis: 気象庁の風の強さの目安で、瞬間風速 30 m/s (平均風速では 20 m/s) とする (not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 気温 (範囲の高い端)
requirements.basis: assumption (the hot end of a -10 to 40 degC range of use)

requirements.name: 人数と荷重の組 (見る組)
requirements.basis: request (2 人乗り、積載 150 kg)
requirements.note: MVP は two_cargo (2 人 + 荷) だけを見る。empty・driver・two はまだ見ない。乗員と荷は設計の部品 (kind occupant / cargo)

requirements.name: 体格の範囲
requirements.value: 若年女性 5 % 〜 若年男性 95 %
requirements.basis: AIST 人体寸法データベース 1991-92, https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/data/list.html (not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 体重 (強さの不利側)
requirements.basis: AIST 人体寸法データベース 1991-92, 項目 N1 体重, 若年男性 95 パーセンタイル, https://www.airc.aist.go.jp/dhrt/91-92/data/list.html (read against the table, 2026-11-03)

requirements.name: 積載
requirements.basis: request
requirements.note: 乗員とは別の荷として扱う (聞いていない)

requirements.name: 荷の重心の高さ (荷台の床から)
requirements.basis: the demo design's cargo: its box centre at 600 mm stands 150 mm above the deck's top at 450 mm (data/designs/offroad-4w-v1.json, parts cargo and deck)

requirements.name: 最高速度
requirements.basis: request

requirements.name: 0 → 最高速度 (Q50) の時間
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 停止距離
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from 細目告示 第171条 第5項 (初速 35 km/h), https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/content/S171.pdf; the table is for vehicles of 25 km/h or less and others, not for this vehicle's class (not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 止まっていられる坂
requirements.basis: assumption: borrowed from 細目告示 第171条 第5項, https://www.mlit.go.jp/jidosha/content/S171.pdf; the table is for vehicles of 25 km/h or less and others, not for this vehicle's class (not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 航続
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 最低地上高
requirements.basis: EU 規則 168/2013 附属書 I (全地形車 L7e-B の下限), https://www.legislation.gov.uk/eur/2013/168/annex/I (not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 倒れない角度 (Q30 の組で)
requirements.basis: fully loaded (two_cargo, as Q30): 24 deg from ROHVA 1 and ANSI B71.9 as summarized in the CPSC staff briefing of 2016-11-22 (PDF p.11), which also gives 33 deg for two people (both read on that page for this repository); 35 deg empty: an assumption (no source found)

requirements.name: 安全率 (降伏に対して)
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 挟み込みの隙間
requirements.basis: ISO 13854:1996 の試し読み, https://cdn.standards.iteh.ai/samples/22598/44d1054ccf4f41e1adefb8020dbaaa13/ISO-13854-1996.pdf (not checked in this repository)

requirements.name: 衝突の速さ
requirements.basis: assumption (the top speed, Q50)

requirements.name: 手の操作部に掛かる力 (握る点、前後・上下・回す向きのそれぞれ)
requirements.basis: assumption: UN Regulation No. 79 (1988 text), table "Steering control effort requirements" (M1, with a failure: 300 N) taken as the largest hand force in use (the table was read; using it as a design load is the assumption)

requirements.name: 手の操作部の握る点の動きの上限 (Q66 の力で)
requirements.basis: assumption (the range where the feel and position of the control do not change; no source)

requirements.name: 足の操作部に掛かる力 (踏む面、踏む向き)
requirements.basis: UN Regulation No. 13-H, Annex 3, 2.1.1 and 2.3.4 (50 daN, read by the intake department on 2026-11-03)

requirements.name: 足の操作部の踏む面の支えの動きの上限 (Q68 の力で)
requirements.basis: assumption (small against the control's travel; no source)

requirements.name: 公道を走るか
requirements.basis: assumption of this fixed file; Q70 is a required question and was not asked

requirements.name: 乗員と部品に掛かる横の加速度
requirements.basis: CPSC NPR 79 FR 68964, § 1422.3(e) (0.70 g; read by the intake department on 2026-11-03). The vehicle's own peak from its dynamics tests counts instead when it is larger

requirements.name: 乗員と部品に掛かる前後の加速度
requirements.basis: CPSC NPR 79 FR 68964, § 1422.3(b)(1) (peak braking coefficient 0.90; read by the intake department on 2026-11-03). The vehicle's own peak counts instead when it is larger

requirements.name: 乗員の肩・腰の位置 (点 R) を外へ押す力 (10 s)
requirements.basis: CPSC NPR 79 FR 68964, § 1422.5(c)(1)-(5) (read by the intake department on 2026-11-03)

requirements.name: Q77 の力を除いたあとの点 R の永久の横の変形の上限
requirements.basis: CPSC NPR 79 FR 68964, § 1422.5(c) (less than 25 mm; read by the intake department on 2026-11-03)

requirements.name: 出荷の形
requirements.basis: assumption

requirements.name: 乗員の空間の荷重の基準の質量 M (横 1.75 M J・後ろ 1.4 M J・上 20 M N)
requirements.basis: assumption (the R4 builder's M). The coefficients 1.75, 1.4 and 20 are OECD Standard Code 4 (February 2026), 3.5.2.1, 3.5.3.1, 3.6.1 (read), borrowed from tractors >= 600 kg; they stay in the R4 builder, the contract having no unit J/kg or N/kg for them

requirements.name: 泥や石を放す踏面の範囲 (車軸の真上から前へ)
requirements.basis: 道路運送車両の保安基準の細目を定める告示 (2023.9.22 版) 第178条 第2項 第1号 (read); a public-road rule for other traffic, borrowed: applying it to the occupants is an assumption

requirements.name: 泥や石を放す踏面の範囲 (車軸の真上から後ろへ)
requirements.basis: the same 第178条 第2項 第1号 (read; borrowed, an assumption as Q87). The tread above the axle beyond this arc counts too (assumption)

requirements.name: 悪路の走行距離 (疲労)
requirements.basis: assumption (no public basis found)

stop_reason: まとめ役が、判定の付いていない分野を残して止まりました (止めるのを 3 回断ったあと、上限で終了)。まだ設計がありません。設計役 (designer) に、get_context の archetypes から型を選んで propose_design で最初の版を作らせてください。版 1 ができると試験の荷重条件が決まります
